scoring_justification: Relaxation times are recomputed from gold linewidth parameters using the paper's Toyozawa and weak-coupling models (T1). Linewidth parameters are result-compared (T0). PL spectrum is structurally checked with gold offsets.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold linewidth fitting parameters from the paper's explicit text (Section IV, step 7)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper text: SA=2.27 meV, SO=0.10 meV, EA=25 meV, EO=48.1 meV, gamma0=29.3 meV, a=2 meV/K, b=10 meV
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values reported in the paper and are the reference for the fitted parameters.

hidden_assets.purpose: expected phonon replica energy offsets (50 and 70 meV below bright exciton) from the paper's PL analysis
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper description: 'Gaussian-type replicas, located approximately 50 and 70 meV below the bright line'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the physically described offsets that the PL spectrum must exhibit.

outputs.description: Temperature-dependent exciton relaxation times for excitons 1–5 at +1% strain, compared to paper-reported values with tolerance.
Fitted linewidth parameters for excitons 1 and 5 at +1% strain, compared to paper-reported values within tolerance.
Phonon-assisted PL spectrum at 10 K and +1% strain; structure and peak positions compared to paper.

output_contract.notes: Scored outputs provide the key numerical results: relaxation times, linewidth parameters, and PL spectrum. The verifier compares them to the paper-reported values using tolerances that account for computational differences.

steps.description: Recompute expected relaxation times for exciton 1 and 5 from gold linewidth parameters; check positivity and monotonicity for all excitons.
Compare each linewidth parameter to the paper's reported values within tolerance.
Detect bright peak and two phonon replicas; check energy offsets and intensity ratio.
